The Mathlib lemmas it uses are only generic tools (`HasDerivAt` composition rules, `norm_add_le`, `mul_le_mul`). I did not run a separate search of Mathlib: since the statement is built entirely on library-specific definitions, Mathlib cannot contain it, either as a duplicate or as a special case.
